levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All five slides are planned and every one names something only your team could say: your numbers, your parts, your decisions.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All five are planned, but one or two would fit any team in the room.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more slides are empty.

criterion: The Five Slides: Five slides, and they are about your blade

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: An image of the team's own work, the numbers filled in, and a Slides link that opens.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Two of the three are there and one is missing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one of the image, numbers or deck link is present.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: None of the three are present.

criterion: Evidence: Real pictures and real numbers

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The student spoke to their slides and explained them without reading off the screen.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The student spoke but read most of what was on the screen.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The student was present but said almost nothing.

criterion: On The Day: You presented your part
